finding: This study aimed to examine the interaction effects of cesarean sections, preterm birth, low birth weight and high birth weight on the risk of neurodevelopmental disorders, including ADHD, ASD, and intellectual disability.
mod_finding: The abstract suggests that the study will examine the interaction between mode of delivery (specifically emergency C-section for high birth weight babies) and risk of ADHD.
birth_weight: Low birth weight and high birth weight mentioned
